from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A paper within the collection, identifying itself and which other collection papers it cites."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of this paper")
    cites_other_collection_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER papers in the provided collection that this paper cites in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
